$Comment: The temple hub's Concourse, where players arrive: the middle lot, laid in smooth chalk brick with a lantern on a pillar at each corner of the landing. Its porter stands on the Porter spot (the placement Zc_Hub_Porter) and sends players back to the temple or out to the overworld. This is a first shell, enough to walk in and out; the real Concourse replaces its prefab. A server owner can move it to another lot or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/hub-districts.json: players then arrive on the scaffolding, and when the Concourse stands nowhere at all the porter waits a few blocks ahead of the arrival.
